kjv_def: give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay
strongs_def: to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of G3563 (ἐπέχω)) to pay attention to
it_def:
1) avere o tenere, applicare, osservare
   1a) dare attenzione a
2) tenere verso, tenere avanti, presente
3) controllare
   3a) ritardare, bloccare
